# Clutter repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the mandatory architecture and regression gate in [docs/implementation-rules.md §7](../docs/implementation-rules.md#7-mandatory-architecture-and-regression-gate-all-contributors-and-ai-agents) for every implementation task. This includes CSS, small fixes and direct-branch changes. Do not publish unverified runtime changes or bypass required tests. If verification is unavailable or fails, stop and report the blocker. Follow the existing architecture and project constraints in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).
